description: WAAREE Radiance 5 kW On-Grid Solar Kit with Installation, Single Phase, Bifacial TOPCon Panels, Inverter, AC/DC Distribution Boxes - Complete Rooftop Solar Solution - Distributed/Packaged by Waaree. Product Details: Product DescriptionThe WAAREE Radiance 5kW On-Grid DCR Solar Kit is a complete all-in-one solar solution designed for Indian homes and small businesses seeking to reduce electricity bills and embrace clean energy. This ready-to-install kit includes premium bifacial TOPCon solar panels, a single-phase on-grid inverter, and all essential balance-of-system components required for seamless rooftop solar integration. It is eligible under the PM Surya Ghar Muft Bijli Yojana subsidy scheme, helping make solar adoption more affordable and sustainable. It delivers reliable performance, easy grid connectivity, and long-term durability- enabling you to save on electricity costs while contributing to a greener future. Please note- installation charges are included in the kit price and will vary based on the site location and areaLegal DisclaimerThe offering includes both the solar kit and standard installation. Additional charges may apply only if extra materials or accessories (such as extended cabling, additional earthing, or site-specific components) are required based on customer request or site conditions. Images are for representation purposes only.
